thread:
Jamie (oncall): seeing a spike in 5xxs for hosted inference in us-west-2, paging since it's noisy and customer-facing
incident-bot: Incident created #INC-2026-1798005555: API 5xx spike — paging route (priority P1)
Jamie (oncall): initial triage — looks like model-serving nodes hitting CPU saturation, autoscaler didn't react fast enough
Maria (sre): confirming on metrics — request CPU > 95% for the redispatcher pool, 503s up. Latency also +120ms for gen endpoints.
Ken (monitoring): headsup: lots of alert churn — rate-limit and worker-queue alerts firing too. I'll mute some non-actionable ones.
Priya (support): we've got two customers reporting degraded responses, flagging for CS ops. ETA?
Jamie (oncall): mitigation: increased Dedicated pool min nodes for us-west-2 from 4 -> 8 (manual scale). Rolling restart on a few overloaded pods.
Aisha (eng): rolling restarts applied, starting to see CPU drop on new nodes joining.
Diego (platform): I pushed temporary routing rule to divert low-priority requests to best-effort pool to reduce pressure.
alerts-bot: Silence created: alerts/noise-prune/us-west-2 - duration 4h - created by Ken (monitoring)
Ken (monitoring): created a targeted silence for the noisy non-actionable alerts (queue-depth-warning, rate-limit-info) — keeping P1/P0 intact. :thumbsup:
Maria (sre): still want to keep the SLO/5xx alert active. Only silenced noisy secondary ones that produce alert storms.
Jamie (oncall): customer impact assessment: ~0.6% of requests returned 5xx across the spike window (10:05–10:28 UTC). Impacted customers: two sustained sessions reported, transient for most.
Priya (support): I patched both customer tickets with status and mitigation steps, will follow up with post-incident note.
Ken (monitoring): logging changes planned: lower alert sensitivity for rate-limit-info where average < 0.1% errors unless 5xx rate > 1% — draft rule below:
Ken (monitoring): ```
- alert: RateLimitNoise
  expr: increase(rate(api_rate_limit_total[5m])) > 100 
  for: 10m
  labels: {severity: info}
  annotations: {runbook: 'only when 5xx_rate > 1% or customer-impact=true'}
```
Aisha (eng): +1 on conditional alerts. We should tie a composite alert that requires both the noise metric and the 5xx SLI breach to avoid mid-level noise.
Diego (platform): I created a dashboard tile for correlated CPU / 5xx / inbound QPS to validate the new threshold visually. URL: https://grafana.example/r/abc123 (shared in the incident channel)
Maria (sre): after scaling and routing diversion, 5xxs dropped to baseline by 10:30 UTC. We'll keep the silence in place while we test the new thresholds.
Jamie (oncall): handoff to next oncall @Maria in 30m. I'll capture remaining follow-ups: 1) formalize threshold change, 2) add dashboard to runbook, 3) validate silence expiration and re-evaluate alerts.
Maria (sre): taking handoff — I'll own the post-incident action list.
Ken (monitoring): action item: implement composite alert and lower sensitivity; will open PR against monitoring repo with tests.
Ken (monitoring): PR: monitoring/alerts#452 — changes include the composite and a reduced frequency window for the rate-limit noise alerts.
Priya (support): please add a short blurb for CS to use when customers ask — what we changed and expected behavior.
Aisha (eng): suggestion: run a short load test (k6) against a staging cluster with the new composite rules to validate we don't suppress legitimate warnings. I can run tomorrow morning.
Maria (sre): also scheduling a 1h post-incident review tomorrow 15:00 UTC to validate dashboards, thresholds, and to check whether the silence can be pruned.
Jamie (oncall): note: we used a maintenance window for the routing change? Diego: did we schedule a maintenance window so downstream alerting knows it's planned?
Diego (platform): added maintenance window tag to the change: maintenance/us-west-2/1798005555 — visible in Alertmanager for correlating alerts.
alerts-bot: Maintenance window scheduled: us-west-2 diversion - start 2026-03-15T10:10:00Z duration 2h
Ken (monitoring): after PR merges I'll kick off canary deploy of the new alert rules to staging, then to prod if green.
Maria (sre): post-incident validation checklist: 
- Confirm silence auto-expiry at 4h and manual prune if safe.
- Run Aisha's k6 test and verify composite rule behaves as expected.
- Update runbook with dashboard links and troubleshooting steps.
- Notify customers with the updated CS blurb.
Priya (support): I'll draft the customer blurb and share in #support for approval.
Jamie (oncall): thanks all. tagging followups: @Ken please add the PR link in this thread when ready, @Aisha schedule the k6 run, @Diego confirm maintenance window metadata shows up in Alertmanager.
Ken (monitoring): PR link: https://git.example/monitoring/pulls/452 — tests added.
Aisha (eng): scheduled k6 run 2026-03-16T09:00Z against staging. Will post results here.
Diego (platform): confirmed maintenance window metadata appears in Alertmanager and Grafana annotations.
Maria (sre): will re-open thread if anything regresses, otherwise I'll close and mark incident as resolved after the review meeting.
